mapper.select: SELECT id FROM ifj_job ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT job.id AS jobId, node.ref_id AS referencedJobId FROM ifj_job job JOIN ifj_job_definition_node node ON node.definition_id = job.current_definition_id WHERE node.node_type = 'JOB' AND node.node_kind = 'EXECUTION' ORDER BY job.id ASC, node.ref_id ASC, node.id ASC
